description_en: Queries the database accounts of a database and whether a user group is authorized to manage each database account
description_zh: 查询用户组已授权和未授权的数据库账户列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-database-accounts-for-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-pe334a03o0h --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id 3 --database-id 36 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDatabaseAccountsForUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user group to query. This operation returns whether the user group is authorized to manage each database account.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html operation to query the user group ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询已授权数据库账户列表的用户组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the database whose database accounts you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758839.html operation to query the database account ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询数据库账户的数据库实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758839.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: database_id

parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.
Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account to query. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的数据库账户名称。最多支持128字符，仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: database_account_name

DatabaseAccounts.description_zh: 查询到的数据库账户列表

DatabaseAccountId.description_en: The ID of the database account

DatabaseAccountName.description_en: The name of the database account

DatabaseId.description_en: The ID of the database to which the database account belongs
DatabaseId.description_zh: 数据库账号所属数据库实例ID

IsAuthorized.description_en:
Indicates whether the user group is authorized to manage the database account. Valid values:

true

false
IsAuthorized.description_zh:
数据库账户是否授权给当前用户。取值：
true：已授权
false：未授权

ProtocolName.description_en:
The protocol used by the database account. Valid values:

MySQL

Oracle

PostgreSQL

SQLServer
ProtocolName.description_zh:
数据库账户的协议名称。取值：

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of database accounts returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的数据库账户总数量
